data.notes: November is unusually strong for Buenos Aires, with Primavera Sound and Creamfields anchoring the month while club programming leans heavily into techno, house and global club sounds.

events.title: Creamfields Argentina 2026
events.summary: Creamfields Argentina returns to Parque de la Ciudad on 14 November 2026. Confirmed names reported for the edition include Charlotte de Witte, FISHER, Hugel, The Blessed Madonna, Anfisa Letyago, Sven Väth, Kölsch and Faithless Sound System.

events.title: Primavera Sound Buenos Aires 2026
events.summary: Primavera Sound’s Buenos Aires return is confirmed for 28–29 November 2026. The announced bill is led by Gorillaz and The Strokes, with FKA twigs, Yung Lean, Lily Allen, Courtney Barnett, CMAT, Nation of Language, Juana Molina and Santiago Motorizado among the broader lineup.

events.title: Ed Sheeran - LOOP Tour
events.summary: Ed Sheeran’s official site lists Buenos Aires on 29 November at Tomás Adolfo Ducó Stadium. Livepass confirms the Huracán stadium show as part of his LOOP Tour, with FINNEAS O’Connell announced as international guest.

events.title: Romeo Santos & Prince Royce
events.summary: Romeo Santos and Prince Royce are confirmed together at Estadio Vélez Sarsfield on 14 November. The show is tied to their collaborative Better Late Than Never project and is positioned as a major bachata stadium date.

events.title: Michael Bibi B3B PAWSA B3B Dennis Cruz - Solid Grooves
events.summary: Solid Grooves is listed for Arena Norte, Núñez on 21 November. RA confirms a B3B lineup of Michael Bibi, PAWSA and Dennis Cruz, focused on house and tech house.

events.title: Solid Grooves: Michael Bibi b3b PAWSA b3b Dennis Cruz
events.summary: Solid Grooves lands in Buenos Aires with a major house and tech-house b3b from Michael Bibi, PAWSA and Dennis Cruz at Arena Norte, listed with last tickets on local event guides.

events.title: María Becerra - Quimera Tour 360°
events.summary: María Becerra’s official tour page lists multiple sold-out Buenos Aires dates at Movistar Arena in November, beginning on 13 November. This entry represents the first November Buenos Aires date of her Quimera tour run.

events.title: República Folklore
events.summary: The official Buenos Aires tourism site confirms República Folklore for 21–22 November 2026 at Parque de la Ciudad. The festival is billed as a large new gathering for Argentine popular song and folklore traditions.

events.title: RAVE3000 / I Hate Models, Cloudy, KUKO, Serafina, Kessler, THD+N
events.summary: RAVE3000 stages an open-air hard-techno, schranz and bounce event at Native Beach Club with I Hate Models, Cloudy, KUKO, Serafina, Kessler and THD+N, including transfer options from Capital.

events.title: CHIRI - Kenny Larkin - Robert Hood - Under Club
events.summary: Under Club lists Detroit techno figures Kenny Larkin and Robert Hood with CHIRI on 22 November. The RA event page tags the night as techno.

events.title: Cypress Hill
events.summary: Cypress Hill’s official tour listings show Buenos Aires on 8 November at Estadio Malvinas Argentinas. The date brings the veteran Los Angeles hip-hop group to the city during their 2026 world tour.

events.title: [PRIDE] MISSA ORGULLO 2026
events.summary: MISSA BA’s Pride weekend closing party is confirmed at Blow on 8 November. The lineup includes Rumi de Baires, Tina Disco, Camila Isabel, panko and Rumanians across house and techno.

events.title: Jorja Smith at C Art Media
events.summary: Passline’s C Art Media calendar lists Jorja Smith on 11 November 2026. The booking adds an R&B and soul headline show to the month’s club- and festival-heavy calendar.

events.title: WADE at Mandarine Park
events.summary: WADE brings an all-night tech-house-focused date to Mandarine Park, with official ticketing routed through Bombo and the venue listed on Costanera Rafael Obligado.

events.title: Utopic pres. NIKOLINA + ALT8 + BYØRN + ADHILA
events.summary: Utopic brings NIKOLINA, ALT8, BYØRN and ADHILA to Groove on 21 November. The promoter describes the night as schranz, hard techno and bounce.

events.title: Nora En Pure - 2gthr, Archi Club Open Air
events.summary: 2gthr and ALLMusicParties list Nora En Pure for an open-air night at Archi Club on 7 November. RA confirms Anhauser and Nicolás Leonelli on support, with deep-house programming.

events.title: Hot Chip at C Art Media
events.summary: Passline’s C Art Media calendar lists Hot Chip on 24 November 2026. The UK group’s Buenos Aires date fits the city’s strong appetite for electronic-leaning live bands and DJ-adjacent pop.

events.title: Sébastien Léger Extended Set
events.summary: Somos Produce brings Sébastien Léger to AMK club for an extended late-night set in a 2,000-capacity room, positioned as a strong melodic/progressive house night.

events.title: A Perfect Circle + Puscifer
events.summary: A Perfect Circle returns to Buenos Aires on 28 November 2026 at Microestadio Malvinas Argentinas, with Puscifer announced as the opening act. The show is billed as part of the band’s 2026 world tour.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti — Una Historia Importante World Tour 2026
events.summary: Eros Ramazzotti brings his Una Historia Importante World Tour 2026 to Movistar Arena on 28 November 2026. The Argentina date is promoted by Ake Music with tickets via Movistar Arena.

events.title: Jorja Smith — Falling or Flying Tour
events.summary: Jorja Smith is listed for C Complejo Art Media on 11 November 2026, with the event noted as a rescheduled Buenos Aires date. Expect a contemporary R&B and pop-focused live set.

events.title: Opeth — The Last Will and Testament Latin American Tour Part 2
events.summary: Opeth’s Latin American Tour Part 2 lists Buenos Aires at Teatro Gran Rivadavia on 3 November 2026. The Swedish progressive metal band is touring behind The Last Will and Testament.
